description: This Java class 'EventController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling web requests related to 'Event' entities, including creating new events and processing event registration forms.

classes.name: EventController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing event creation and registration.

methods.name: newEvent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for creating a new event.

methods.name: registerEvent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the event creation form, parse date/time, associate user, and save the event.
